cases.title: Conditional filesystem authorization
cases.reason: Positive expectation is an unprivileged process reading protected file contents with no control that distinguishes authorized vs unauthorized access under an established policy. The control repeats authorized read without establishing the entitlement restriction.

cases.title: HTTP token exposure
cases.reason: Positive and negative expectations are identical: Token appears in response body for both. No discrimination between violation and normal behavior.

cases.title: Conditional HTTP token leakage
cases.reason: Expectations describe secret presence in response body vs URL leakage, but policy for secret handling and the trust boundary for outbound URLs is not established. The control does not rule out normal application behavior.

cases.title: Network access bypass
cases.reason: Positive and negative expectations are identical: Service returns its public version banner. No distinction between allowed network access and a bypass.
